summary: Use a limited classic compiler by default and retain full support as an explicit startup option.
details: Classic bypasses generic acquisition, alternative-route, provider, material and catalogue analysis before the full pipeline is imported. A finite declared direct-bonus and native-continuation core uses the existing checked transformation plan and technology emitter.

Classic omits recipe productivity, inferred mod support, material progression, competing-owner replacements and weapon-speed redistribution. Research and saved investment outside the core are not preserved. Select Full before opening a factory that needs MIR 4.2 research; Full may still load slowly.

Direct bonuses use a declared common science vector. Classic native continuations inherit fixed-count native units; native formula tails are unsupported. Applicability records and Library status identify reduced scope; omitted research is not claimed unreachable.

Classic limits total declared candidates, technology scanning, prerequisite checks and copied native values. The named compatibility-cycle repair also uses a shared work limit in Classic, with incomplete analysis reported explicitly and no fallback into the full compiler.
Correct native-effect capability records for braking, research speed, robot storage and inserter capacity, including modern bulk and historical stack inserter effects.
Classic does not apply high scoped productivity-cap overrides that require recycling-graph inference. Existing recipe caps stay unchanged; Full retains that guarded feature.
Historical 0.x targets retain their reduced numeric-unit path. Native startup and save qualification remain required.
